title: Muse’s ComfyUI repository was linked
summary: On 2026-08-20, the Muse development thread pointed readers to its GitHub repository. The sealed evidence establishes a dated public source-location reference, but does not establish a specific release, feature, version, or code change. This event is retained as the project’s historical repository reference.
